title: Geologic map of the North Augusta quadrangle, Aiken and Edgefield counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., and Howard, C.S., 2008, Geologic map of the North Augusta quadrangle, Aiken and Edgefield counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-43, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face is OCR noise. Section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 10, sea level, feet and meters) read from page images: 11 drill holes with labels, top and bottom elevations and units read off the section's own scale (inferred). Holes drawn dashed above the profile (19-065, 19-056, 2-788, 2-164) appear projected and get only top elevation and drawn length. No horizontal distance scale, so contacts and distances along the section are not recorded. Section unit labels Tuu (orange top unit; apparently the upland unit / Altamaha), Qcb, U UKs and L UKs are used as drawn. OCR misreads: '40A1/39Ar' read as 40Ar/39Ar; '| km' read as 1 km; several unit symbols garbled ('Tab', 'Qet', 'mm', '[vam ]', 'Joon') and not recorded. Heading 'Lower Cretaceous sediments, lower unit' describes the lower part of the Upper Cretaceous sediments; no age recorded. SUBSURFACE: basement surface structure contours (Figure 1 and discussion) give only slopes, 37 ft/mi northwest to southeast and 16.5 ft/mi west to east, no point elevations; Figure 1 is a schematic basement map without values.
